issues.failure_explanation: The semi-discrete system (P_h) is posed with discrete initial data (p^h_0, p^h_1, u^h_0) in (V_h^q)^3. While Theorem 3.1 explicitly assumes that the acoustic initial conditions interpolate the exact data, (p^h_0, p^h_1) = (I_h p_0, I_h p_1), Theorem 4.1 places no condition on u^h_0. In the proof of Theorem 4.1, integrating (4.7) from 0 to t produces an initial discrete error term ||e^{h,u}(0)||_{L^2(\Omega)}^2 = ||I_h u_0 - u^h_0||_{L^2(\Omega)}^2, which is implicitly dropped as if it were bounded by O(h^{2q}). If u^h_0 is arbitrary in V_h^q, ||u(0) - u^h(0)||_{L^2(\Omega)} can be O(1), directly contradicting the claimed O(h^{2q}) error bound.

failure_location.quote:
Then there exist $M>0$ and $\barh>0$, such that if
	\[
	\|p\|_{\COmegaT} \leq M \qquad \text{and} \quad h \leq \barh,
	\]
	then there is a unique solution $(\ph,\uh) \in C^{2}([0,T];\Vhq) \times C^{1}([0,T];\Vhq)$ of \eqref{dG semi-discrete wave-adv diff system}.
	Furthermore, the approximate pressure satisfies the error estimate \eqref{error bound pressure} and the approximate concentration satisfies
	\begin{eq}
		\Ltwonorm{u(t)-\uh(t)}{\Omega}^{2} + \int_{0}^{t} \dgseminorm{u-\uh}^{2} \ds \lesssim h^{2q},
	\end{eq}

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the hypothesis to Theorem 4.1 that u^h_0 = I_h u_0 (or, more generally, ||u^h_0 - I_h u_0||_{L^2(\Omega)} <= C h^q).
issues.overall_effect: The error estimate for the approximate concentration in Theorem 4.1 fails to hold without an accuracy assumption on the discrete initial concentration u^h_0.
issues.title: Omitted hypothesis on initial concentration data in Theorem 4.1
issues.why_classification: Specifying the standard discrete initial condition u^h_0 = I_h u_0 is a routine local addition of an omitted premise that fully preserves the proof, all convergence rates, and the advertised scope of the result without any new proof architecture or lemma.
